warnings.message: (7FE0,0010) Pixel Data (OW, 8 byte(s)) is present and was stepped over without being read. Pixel data is never read, never stored and never analysed. Apiome imports DICOM's metadata layer — the file meta information, the attribute structure and Structured Report content trees — and steps over every Pixel Data, Float Pixel Data, Double Float Pixel Data and Overlay Data value by its declared length without decoding it. Each one is recorded as present and skipped, with its VR and length, so its absence from the model is stated, not implied.
Dataset 0 carries 1 private attribute(s). Their tag, VR and length are recorded; their meaning is not in the DICOM data dictionary and is not modelled.
